data.research_question: To what extent have U.S. and Israeli military structures become functionally integrated without a formal merged chain of command?
hypotheses: Operational, procurement, missile-defense, logistics, and liaison mechanisms create functional integration.
The relationship remains legally and organizationally bilateral rather than a unified military command.
